why: The one statement of the durable-wallpaper reference rule. bin/vshell_helper.py owns it as portable_ref, recovered_package_ref and resolve_path; quickshell/vshell/Common/Paths.qml mirrors it for session.json, which the shell writes without the helper. scripts/test-wallpaper-refs.py and scripts/test-wallpaper-refs.js each run their own side against these rows, so the two implementations cannot drift apart without one of them going red.
refWhy: Recording: portable_ref, and resolved as the round trip back through resolve_path. One containment test, so a path this installation does not own is recorded as it stands.

ref.why: a built-in package's background under the running root becomes a rooted reference
anything else under the root is rooted too, such as the branding image a hook falls back to
a user package does not move with the shell, so its background stays absolute
a path another installation wrote is recorded as it stands; repairing it is the read side's job
a directory outside VGS shaped like a package is recorded as it stands, so a picked wallpaper that loads keeps loading
a picture the user chose outside VGS is left alone
a system wallpaper outside both roots is left alone
the colour literal setWallpaperColor stores in the same field is not a path
a reference already in reference form is recorded unchanged and still resolves

resolveWhy: The resolver alone: resolve_path, on every reference form durable state carries.

resolve.why: a rooted reference resolves against the root the shell is running from
a home-relative reference, the form target destinations are written in, resolves too
an absolute path is already resolved
no reference resolves to no path

recoverWhy: Reading: resolved_wallpaper, which repairs a package background another installation recorded before resolving. A path under either of this installation's roots is never repaired.

recover.why: a package background recorded by a checkout that is gone names this installation's copy
a user package is this installation's own and is never repaired
a background already under the running root is never repaired
a rooted reference needs no repair and resolves
a picture outside VGS naming no package is left alone
no wallpaper reads back as nothing
